name: Nyxathel, Shadow Lord
description: An ancient sovereign of shadow, secrets, and forbidden devotion.

stages.title: Shadow Touched
stages.description: The first veil parts, and the dark begins to notice you.
rewards: title @s actionbar {"text":"A hush falls around you.","color":"dark_purple"}

stages.title: Dark Acolyte
stages.description: You have learned to hear the quiet promises hidden in darkness.

stages.title: Shadow Priest
stages.description: Nyxathel entrusts you with rites meant for candleless places.

stages.title: Void Master
stages.description: The boundary between thought and shadow yields before you.

stages.title: Shadow Champion
stages.description: You stand as Nyxathel's chosen instrument in the midnight veil.

abandon.message: §4Nyxathel withdraws the sheltering veil. §8The dark remembers betrayal.
